registry_meta.operator_directive_intent: Build a Hugging Face Visual Model Registry + Benchmark Lab FIRST, rather than blindly integrating models. Run the same Toscanini canonical geometry through candidates and objectively determine which model improves presentation WITHOUT corrupting engineering truth.
registry_meta.epistemic_rule: Canonical geometry is Coder 1's engineering truth. Every lab output is presentation (COMPUTATIONAL_RENDER at most). No AI-generated mesh may replace canonical geometry, enter the engineering GLB chain, or be presented as engineering or physical validation (Constitution Art. LXXII, XXXVIII, VI).
registry_meta.single_source_of_truth_chain: Coder 1 canonical geometry -> GLB -> Coder 2 renderer -> visual compiler -> website -> buyer package
